name: Default
shortDescription: Continuous delivery server for modelling and visualising build, test and deploy pipelines, with one build agent included.

alerts.message: GoCD starts with no authentication: anyone who can reach the URL has full admin access. Configure an authorization plugin (for example the bundled password file plugin) under Admin > Security > Authorization Configuration right after the first start.
The bundled agent registers as Pending. Enable it on the Agents page before running pipelines.
